problem: Four persistent baseline failures already disclosed an answer-bearing document, but fixed head previews hid the answer. The accepted target slate and section-aware selector solve document and span availability separately; the remaining question is whether a bounded verifier can repair the final answer without perturbing exploration or introducing unsupported replacements.
simplest_baseline: Keep the completed v10 baseline answer unchanged. The rejected v14 alternative globally exposed an open tool during exploration and changed behavior even when no useful document was opened.
hypothesis: A post-run overlay that leaves the baseline trace untouched, selects at most four already-disclosed documents, opens one deterministic section-aware span per target, and accepts a verifier's replacement only when the short answer is literally present in its cited span will produce at least three Judge-correct and strict-exact repairs among the four diagnosed failures with zero unsupported replacements.
changed_mechanisms: bounded post-run evidence overlay with literal-support replacement gate
anti_claim: This is a paid, outcome-selected development calibration on known failures. It measures a frozen-model harness repair and cannot be reported as model capability improvement, fresh-slice accuracy, or leaderboard performance.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: Role expansion can alter the whole trajectory. The overlay is deliberately narrower: it repairs only an unresolved terminal claim from already-collected evidence and is forced to keep the baseline when support is absent.
A full synthesis pass may rewrite supported content as well as errors. This overlay constrains the repair surface to a typed short answer with literal cited support.
The measured issue is evidence visibility after collection, so a bounded verifier before publishing is cheaper and more causally targeted than another crawl.
Graph fan-out targets missing research branches. These cases have answer-bearing documents already, so the overlay pays only for verification of residual Evidence Debt.

claim_boundary: A pass authorizes a preregistered fresh development paired test with a separate Token-matched or cost-matched control. It does not authorize sealed holdout access or a benchmark-ranking claim.
